subject: Dashboard tiles not loading for whole team
body: Since Monday several of our sales dashboards are stuck on the loading spinner for most of the team, not just me. Cleared cache, tried a different browser, no change. Can someone look at this today, we present these numbers to the board on Friday.

subject: Connector to our warehouse keeps dropping
body: The Snowflake connector has failed silently twice this week, we only noticed because the numbers looked stale. Please check what's going on, this is exactly the kind of thing an alert should have caught.

subject: PDF export cutting off right-hand columns
body: Exporting the quarterly report to PDF chops off the last two columns no matter what page size I pick. Worked fine a few weeks ago. Can you check the export renderer?

subject: Same dashboard problem as August, still not fixed
body: The dashboard loading issue from August is back, and this time it's worse, full page timeouts rather than slow tiles. We reported this once already. Need an actual fix, not a workaround.

subject: Alert thresholds silently reset
body: Our revenue alerts stopped firing last week and when I checked, half the thresholds had reverted to default values. Nobody on our side touched them. Can you confirm what happened and get them restored?

subject: Dashboards down over the holidays
body: Dashboards have been unusable since yesterday, blank tiles across the board. Terrible timing right before year-end reporting. This is the third dashboard problem since August and each one seems to take longer to sort than the last.

subject: Report builder crashing on save, need this escalated
body: Report builder has crashed on save four times today, losing my work each time. I've raised smaller issues before but this one is blocking actual deliverables. Please escalate, we need someone senior looking at this, not just first-line support.

subject: Connector failures again, this keeps happening
body: Data connectors dropped out again overnight, same pattern as last year. Between this and the report builder crashes Ingrid flagged, our finance team is starting to ask hard questions about reliability. We need a real explanation, not another ticket closed as resolved.

subject: Report builder still unstable, formulas disappearing
body: On top of the crashes reported last month, formulas in saved reports are now vanishing on reopen. Same module that's been broken since May. We need a proper root-cause fix, and honestly an update on where things stand given the string of problems this year.

subject: Report builder fix, can confirm it's working
body: Following up on the report builder crashes and disappearing formulas, your team pushed a patch last week and I've had the whole team stress-test it since. No crashes, formulas holding. Appreciate someone finally taking this seriously.

subject: Alert configuration question
body: Quick one, want to set up a new alert for our EU sales pipeline hitting a threshold. Can you point me to the right setup, or is this something support needs to configure on your end?

subject: Connector sync timing
body: Noticed our nightly connector sync is running about two hours later than it used to. Not urgent, but would like to understand if that's expected or something changed on your side.

subject: Custom template request
body: We'd like to build a custom report template with our own header and footer branding. Is that something report builder supports natively, or do we need a workaround?

subject: API rate limit for new integration
body: We're building a small internal tool that pulls dashboard data via the API. What's the current rate limit on the Standard plan, and is it per key or per account?

subject: Thanks, template question answered
body: Got the template working with the guidance from earlier this week, looks great. One follow-up, can the header logo differ per report, or is it account-wide?

subject: Alert recipient list update
body: Need to update the recipient list on three of our alerts, a couple of people have left the finance team. Can you point me to where that's managed, or should I just do it myself in admin?

subject: API docs for new webhook endpoint
body: Saw mention of a new webhook endpoint in the changelog but can't find documentation for it. Could you send the spec over, or let me know if it's not public yet?

subject: Export scheduling to shared drive
body: Is it possible to schedule exports to land directly in a shared network drive rather than email? Would save our team a manual step every week.

subject: Adding a new data source
body: We're bringing on a new supplier data feed and want to connect it via the standard connector. Can you confirm which formats are supported before we start mapping fields?

subject: Year-end report layout question
body: Putting together our year-end report and want to combine two templates into one. Is there a clean way to do that in report builder, or do we need to build a new one from scratch?

subject: MySQL connector authentication error after password rotation
body: We rotated our database credentials last week as part of a security review. After updating the connection credentials in Kataja, the MySQL connector is now returning an authentication error. The credentials are correct — I have verified them directly against the database. Is there a caching issue on your side, or a specific step required after updating credentials?

subject: Connector sync frequency — can we increase to every 15 minutes?
body: We are currently syncing hourly via the MySQL connector. Is it possible to configure a 15-minute sync interval on our plan? If not available on Professional, let me know whether that requires an upgrade. Thanks.

subject: Report builder won't save, urgent
body: Report builder keeps throwing an error on save, lost twenty minutes of work. Need this fixed today, we have a client call this afternoon.

subject: Connector down since this morning
body: Our main connector has been failing since 8am. No dashboards updating. Please look into this now.

subject: Exports blank AGAIN
body: Same day, exports are coming out completely blank. Two things broken at once is not a great look.

subject: Dashboards frozen
body: Now the dashboards themselves won't load. Third issue in two days. Someone please call me.

subject: Report builder error over the holidays
body: Trying to finish year-end reporting and report builder is throwing the same save error as back in August. Please tell me this isn't a recurring bug.

subject: Alerts not firing
body: None of our alerts have fired in three days. Found out the hard way when a threshold breach went unnoticed. Not acceptable.

subject: Connector errors, same day as the alerts issue
body: On top of the alert problem I just reported, the connector is now throwing sync errors too. Feels like everything is falling over at once this week.

subject: Can't add new user
body: Trying to add a new starter to the account and the invite keeps failing silently. Need this sorted, she starts Monday.

subject: Still can't add the new user
body: Following up from yesterday, the invite issue is still there. She's supposed to start today and has no access.

subject: API key stopped working
body: The API key we use for the nightly pull stopped authenticating this morning, no changes on our end. Rough week for us with this account overall.

subject: Export scheduler skipped again
body: The scheduled export didn't run this morning. Second time this quarter. Please just fix the scheduler properly.

subject: Dashboard widgets missing
body: Half our dashboard widgets have vanished since the weekend. Nothing changed on our side.

subject: Connector sync errors, same day
body: The connector is throwing errors again too, feels like the same bad patch as March. Please look at both issues together if they're related.

subject: Report builder freezing on large reports
body: Report builder now freezes the browser tab on anything over twenty pages. Can't get our monthly pack out.

subject: Export format wrong
body: Exports are coming out as CSV instead of the PDF format we've had configured for a year. Please revert it.

subject: Report builder error, back again
body: The same save error from earlier this year is back in report builder. I know it gets fixed quickly but this is getting repetitive.

subject: Seat count wrong on invoice
body: Our latest invoice shows two more seats than we actually have active. Can someone check the seat count and correct it?

subject: Export missing a whole section
body: Yesterday's export is missing the summary section entirely. Second export problem in two days for us.

subject: Report builder down for year-end again
body: Here we are at year-end again and report builder has thrown an error mid-save. Feels like a pattern at this point, though I'll say your team always sorts it fast.

subject: Same report builder error, different report
body: Filed one of these an hour ago, now it's happening on a second report too. Please just get someone to look at the whole module.

subject: Setting up new connector for ERP
body: We'd like to connect our ERP system as a new data source. Could you send over the setup guide or let us know what's needed to get started?

subject: Formatting question in report builder
body: Is there a way to set a default currency format across all reports rather than per report? Would save us some time.

subject: Export template update
body: We'd like to update our standard export template to include the new cost centre field. Can you point us to where that's configured?

subject: Alert recipients
body: Adding two new people to our monthly variance alert. Where do we manage the recipient list?

subject: API access for new BI tool
body: We're evaluating a new internal BI tool that would pull data via your API. Could you confirm the authentication method and whether there's a sandbox environment we can test against?

subject: Alert configuration for multiple business units
body: We have four business units and want separate alert thresholds for each. Is that supported natively or do we need to set up separate accounts?

subject: Question on alert frequency
body: Can alerts be set to a daily digest instead of firing immediately each time? We're getting too many individual emails.

subject: Following up on the alert digest question
body: Astrid raised the digest question a few days ago, just checking if there's an update, we'd like to get this set up before month end.

subject: Adding a chart type to report builder
body: Is it possible to add a waterfall chart to a report, or is that limited to the dashboard view?

subject: Scheduled export time
body: Can we change the time our weekly export runs? Currently 6am local, we'd prefer it after our overnight batch finishes at 8am.

subject: API documentation for connector endpoint
body: Looking for documentation on the connector status endpoint, want to build a small internal monitor. Could you point us to the right page?

subject: API token expiry
body: Our API token expired without much warning. Is there a way to get notified ahead of expiry next time?

subject: New API key for second integration
body: We need a second API key for a separate integration project. Can you issue one, and confirm it doesn't affect the existing one's limits?

subject: Export file naming convention
body: Would it be possible to customise the file naming pattern on scheduled exports? Right now they all just say export.csv, which is a bit of a pain to sort through.

subject: Dashboard load time — performance degradation
body: We have noticed over the past few weeks that our main reporting dashboard is taking considerably longer to load than it used to — currently around 25–30 seconds, where previously it was under 10. The dashboard has not changed significantly. I am raising this now as it is becoming a friction point for the team, though we are managing for the moment.

subject: API key scope — read vs write permissions
body: We would like to create a read-only API key for a third-party integration without exposing write access. Is it possible to generate a scoped API key, or does every key have full access? If scoped keys are not available, please log this as a request.

subject: Seat allocation unclear — billing vs active users
body: We have been reviewing our account ahead of the renewal period and I am finding it difficult to reconcile the seat count shown in Admin with our actual active users. The admin panel shows 12 seats in use but when I list active accounts I count only 8 people who have logged in during the past 90 days. I raised a similar question via the renewal process last year and did not receive a clear answer. Could someone from your team please explain how seats are counted and whether we are being billed for inactive users? We are also still waiting for a resolution to an issue raised in December regarding dashboard performance, which has not been fully addressed.

subject: Scheduled report not delivering — intermittent
body: Our Tuesday morning report has failed to deliver on two occasions in the past three weeks — 31 December and 7 January. The report shows as 'completed' in the scheduler log but no email arrives. This is a report our head of finance relies on first thing Tuesday morning so missed deliveries are disruptive. We have a workaround in place (manual download) but would prefer the scheduler to work reliably.

subject: Report scheduler broken AGAIN
body: Tuesday report missed delivery again — third time now. The January ticket is marked as resolved but nothing has actually changed. Please stop closing tickets without fixing the underlying problem.

subject: Report builder — calculated field error appearing on some runs
body: We have a report with a calculated field that returns a division-by-zero error on approximately 30% of scheduled runs. The field includes a null check that should prevent this, but the error appears anyway. The report was working without issue until mid-January. I have attached a screenshot of the error message. Given the number of open and recently closed issues we have had since December, I would appreciate a more thorough investigation rather than a quick configuration check and close.

subject: Alert emails going to spam
body: Noting that alert notification emails have been landing in spam for several users on our team. Flagging for your awareness. We have added the sending domain to our allowlist as a workaround.

subject: Report template — column header formatting lost on export
body: Column headers lose their formatting (bold, background colour) when a report is exported to Excel. The formatting is visible in the preview and in the on-screen view. This is a minor issue and we can reformat manually, but worth logging.

subject: Connector sync error — intermittent
body: The PostgreSQL connector is showing occasional sync failures — roughly one in five syncs fails with a timeout. The next sync usually completes fine. Raising so there is a record of it.

subject: Connector — schema drift notification
body: One of our source tables had a column renamed last month. The connector did not flag this and has been silently mapping the old column name to null since then. We only noticed when a report started returning zeros. Is there a way to enable notifications for schema changes, or does the connector not currently detect this?

subject: Connector auth failing intermittently
body: Our main connector keeps dropping authentication a couple of times a week. Nothing's changed on our side. Can you check what's causing it?

subject: Can't deactivate former employee's seat
body: Trying to remove a seat for someone who left in October and it won't deactivate, keeps erroring out. Meanwhile we're still being billed for it.

subject: Dashboards unusably slow
body: Dashboards have gone from loading in seconds to taking over a minute, sometimes timing out completely. This has been going on for a week now and it's affecting daily standups.

subject: Exports failing since dashboards went slow
body: On top of the dashboard slowness from three weeks ago, exports are now timing out too. Twelve days and counting on the last issue with no resolution, now this.

subject: Escalating, report builder broken, third module this quarter
body: Report builder is now crashing on open for two of our saved reports. Between this, the dashboard slowness, and the export failures, that's three modules broken in a month. I need this escalated to someone who can give us a real timeline.

subject: Dashboards down again, still no word on the rest
body: Dashboards are now fully down, not just slow. I haven't had a proper update on the report builder crash from last week either. This is becoming a pattern we can't keep working around.

subject: API question, things seem stable now
body: Since your team sorted out the connector, dashboard and export issues over the winter, things have been running smoothly. Quick question, what's the API rate limit on our plan? We're scoping a small integration.

subject: Follow-up on the API rate limit
body: Thanks for the answer yesterday. One more, does the rate limit reset on a rolling window or a fixed hourly boundary? Want to design the integration around it properly.

subject: Bulk seat update
body: Need to add three new seats and remove one old one ahead of our new hires starting next month. Can you process this as a batch?

subject: New dashboard widget request
body: Is there a widget type for showing rolling twelve-month trends? Would be useful for our ops review.

subject: New connector for secondary warehouse
body: We're adding a second data warehouse and want to set up a connector for it. Can you confirm the supported source types before we start mapping?

subject: Export file naming convention
body: Is there a way to customise the file naming pattern for scheduled exports? Currently they all save with a generic timestamp, and it would help our finance archive if we could include the report name and period directly in the filename instead. Not urgent, just tidying up our document management on our end.

subject: Scheduled export failing on Fridays specifically
body: We've noticed the weekly operations export consistently fails to generate on Fridays, though the same report runs fine every other day of the week when triggered manually. This has been going on for the past month or so - we just didn't get around to reporting it sooner. Could you check whether there's something specific to the Friday schedule slot, like a maintenance window overlapping with our trigger time?

subject: Report builder - board pack template question
body: We're rebuilding our quarterly board pack template and want to check whether report builder supports embedding a cover page with static text and our own branding ahead of the data tables, or whether that needs to be assembled outside the platform each time. As part of a lighter-touch review of our reporting stack this year we also looked briefly at Dashlume's template options, mainly out of curiosity about how others handle this.

subject: Friday export issue - update from our side
body: Following up on the Friday export failure from June, which never fully resolved - we've since set up a manual trigger reminder for ourselves each Friday morning as a backstop, so it's not causing any real disruption anymore. Also wanted to flag that the alert notifying us of export failures doesn't seem to fire either, which is really how we noticed the pattern in the first place rather than any warning from the platform. Comparing notes with Dashlume periodically but no decisions made; no urgency needed on either point.

subject: Connector broke overnight
body: Connector stopped syncing overnight, dashboards showing yesterday's numbers. Need this looked at now, we run our morning meeting off this.

subject: Seat issue same week
body: On top of yesterday's connector problem, now a seat I added last week has disappeared from the account. Not a great week for us with this platform.

subject: Connector down again
body: Same connector issue as the summer, dropped sync overnight, no changes on our end. Please check if it's the same root cause.

subject: Export failing, same day
body: Exports are also failing today. Two issues on the same day again, feels familiar.

subject: Dashboards blank on Christmas Day
body: Of all days, dashboards are completely blank today. We do check numbers over the holidays, please get someone on this.

subject: Report builder crash right after the dashboard fix
body: Dashboards came back but now report builder is crashing on save. Feels like whack-a-mole with this account lately.

subject: Connector sync failure, here we go again
body: Connector's dropped sync again, third time this has happened. I know it gets fixed quickly each time but it keeps coming back.

subject: API errors, same week as the connector issue
body: API calls are erroring out with 500s since yesterday. Following the connector problem from yesterday, wondering if these are related.

subject: Connector down a second time this week
body: Connector's failed again, second time in three days. Please look at whatever's causing the instability, not just the symptom.

subject: Dashboards affected too now
body: Following the connector and API issues this week, dashboards are now showing stale data as well. Rough few days for us.

subject: Connector, again, same week
body: Sorry for another one, connector dropped a third time this week. Please escalate internally if you haven't already.

subject: Dashboards frozen
body: Dashboards frozen since this morning, nothing loading past the header. Need this fixed today please.

subject: API auth error
body: API key stopped authenticating two days after the dashboard issue was fixed. Feels like these things come in waves for us.

subject: Can't remove old seat
body: Trying to deactivate a seat for someone who left last month and it's stuck. Meanwhile we're being billed for it still.

subject: Dashboards slow again
body: Dashboards crawling again, same symptoms as back in June. Please check if it's the same cause.

subject: Connector down for year-end

subject: Alerts not firing, same day as the connector issue
body: On top of the connector problem I just reported, our month-end alerts haven't fired either. Everything at once again.

subject: Adding seats for new office
body: We're opening a new regional office and need to add eight seats under a separate user group. Can you talk us through the best way to structure this in admin?

subject: Connector sync failing since last week
body: Our connector has failed to sync properly since last Tuesday. We've tried reconnecting twice. Dashboards are running on old data and it's starting to matter for our reporting.

subject: API errors on data pull
body: Getting intermittent 500 errors on our nightly API pull for the past few days. Still waiting on a proper fix for the connector issue Ingrid raised a couple of months back too, for what it's worth.

subject: Still broken, API and connector both unreliable
body: The API errors from December are still happening, and the connector problem I raised in October has never really been resolved either, it's just quieter. Ten days is a long time to wait on something affecting our core data pipeline. We need someone to actually own this.

subject: Alerts silent during the API outage
body: During the API problems, none of our failure alerts fired to warn us. That's the whole point of having them. Combined with everything else this account has been through recently, confidence is pretty low right now.

subject: Escalating, ongoing reliability problems
body: Between the connector issues from the autumn, the API errors since December, and alerts not firing in February, we need this escalated properly. This isn't a one-off, it's a pattern across several months and it needs a named owner on your side.

subject: Report builder crashing, following the escalation
body: Since Ingrid's escalation in the spring things had improved, but now report builder is crashing on our monthly pack. Flagging it under the same escalation thread given the history here.

subject: Export issue, hoping this is the last one
body: Small export formatting issue this time, nothing like the scale of what we've dealt with this year. Your team has been responsive since the escalation, appreciated.

subject: Seat count discrepancy
body: Our admin panel shows one more active seat than we have people using the account. Not urgent, just want it corrected before next invoice.

subject: Dashboard enhancement request
body: Things have been steady for a while now, thank you. Separately, any plans to support custom colour themes on dashboards? Would help us match internal branding.

subject: API pagination

subject: Export missing data over year-end

subject: Escalating, exports still unreliable

body: Small formatting issue on today's export, a column header shifted. Nothing like the scale of earlier this year, and it was sorted quickly, thank you.
